recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Federal parliamentary republic.
rulers: President Asif Ali ZARDARI (since 10 March 2024); Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz SHARIF (since 3 March 2024)
economy: lower middle-income South Asian economy; extremely high debt; endemic corruption; regional disputes with India and Afghanistan hinder investment; falling inflation, IMF relief programs, and strong agricultural output slowly contributing to economic recovery GDP (PPP): $1.39 trillion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Pakistan Armed Forces: Pakistan Army (includes National Guard), Pakistan Navy (includes Pakistan Marines, Pakistan Maritime Security Agency), Pakistan Air Force Ministry of Interior: Frontier Constabulary, Frontier Corps, National Police, Pakistan Coast Guard, Punjab (Pakistan) Rangers, Sindh (Pakistan) Rangers (2025) Expenditure: 2.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
